research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Sunfolding is researching and developing solar tracker arrays and systems, as described in titles such as Pneumatic actuator system and method and Fluidic solar array actuation system, which detail arrays of solar trackers using fluidic or pneumatic actuation. Additional work includes tracker system arrays, dampening assemblies for solar trackers, solar module leading edge systems, photovoltaic module clamp systems, fluidic actuator locking mechanisms, and inflatable bladder systems for actuation. These efforts focus on innovative solar tracking technologies.

overview_description.description:
Sunfolding was founded in 2012 with headquarters in San Francisco, California. Sunfolding designs, manufactures, and sells balance of system products that provide cost and performance breakthroughs to stakeholders across the solar sector. The company's main product delivers an advanced solar tracker, Sunfolding T29 Horizontal Single Axis Tracker. The product features Sunfolding’s AirDrive technology, which uses the strength and resilience of wear-free automotive components to replace problematic tracker motors, gearboxes, and other wear surfaces. It makes design and installation easy, with a streamlined and inherently robust design, fewer components, and greater layout flexibility.

The company's executive team has collectively built and sold GWs of solar globally, successfully launching new solar products and technologies at leading solar companies including First Solar, SMA America, Kaco, and SunPower. The Sunfolding team is a blend of top technical talent with recognized industry leaders.
